{{Quote|Welcome, honored guests, to the famous Spas at Skull Ridge Mountain.|A human hotelier to the crew of the ''Onyx Cinder''|<ref name="SC 105" />}}
During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''human''' worked as a hotel director at [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. Around [[9 ABY]], she welcomed [[Jod Na Nawood]] and a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[youngling]]s who were posing as "Wise Elders" from the [[Bratric system]]. During their visit, she accepted a bribe from Na Nawood to allow him to check in as [[Professor]] [[Umiam Gorelox]] and overlook the fact that the Wise Elders were in fact children.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Luxury. That's our obsession here at the spa. Luxury served by indulging each guest's unique proclivities.|A human hotelier to the crew of the ''Onyx Cinder''|<ref name="SC 105" />}}
She was [[human]] hotel director of the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]].<ref name="SC 105" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> she<ref name="SC 105 AD" /> watched the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'' touch down on at the Spa. Noticing the junky state of the ship when it touches down she frowns and informs a guard to contact waste removal expecting that the ''Onyx Cinder'' might cause a situation. She then processed to welcome [[Jod Na Nawood]] and a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[youngling]]s who were posing as "Wise Elders" from the [[Bratric system]]. After the group is scanned for weapons and their [[droid]] [[SM-33]] is fitted with a [[restraining bolt]] she guides them through the hotel while pointing out the [[Sensory Gymnasium]] and [[Mud Pits]].<ref name="SC 105" />

Afterwards she proceeds to try to check the group in, asking them what name their reservation was under. Instead of supplying a name, Na Nawood placed an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] credit which she accepts and inquires about the "Wise Elders" to which Na Nawood produces another credit for her. He leans over to the terminal and points to [[Professor]] [[Umiam Gorelox]]'s entry claiming it was him and asked to upgrade to a fine suite while producing another credit. However before she can check them in a [[bounty hunter]] named [[Pokkit]] approaches Na Nawood addressing him as Dash Zentin and discussing how he stole a bounty from her before and that she later couldn't find anyone named Dash Zentin. After the exchange, the hotelier asked Na Nawood what name the reservation was under again to which he produced two handfuls of credits.<ref name="SC 105" />

Later, the hotel director was supervising a cleanup crew outside the ''Onyx Cinder'' when two [[pirate]] [[starship]]s from [[Brutus]]'s [[Silvo's pirates|pirate group]] land to attack and capture the Na Nawood and the younglings.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Personality and traits==
She was a human with long [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Equipment==
While working at the spa, she wore a beige hotel [[Clothing|uniform]] with a matching [[hat|cap]] along with red lipstick.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hotelier debuted in ''[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode that premiered on [[December 25]], [[2024]].
